decision: Use the precise current operator/investor total in the new catalogue-based reconstruction; preserve the normalized legacy inventory as history. This is a source correction, not deleting rooms to make a packing test pass.

corroboration.status: Historical plan, not independently current room schedule

source_limitations: Exact per-category and per-floor operator counts remain unknown.
Legacy normalized suite type and amenity counts were reconstruction, not operator facts.
Current category pages distinguish variants; e.g Chairman3-bedroom520sqm and4-bedroom630sqm, rather than applying an old pooled average universally.
